title: Senior Theatre Practitioner – Anaesthetics (Recovery Support)
description: Purpose of Job Role The Senior Theatre Practitioner – Anaesthetics is responsible for delivering safe, high-quality anaesthetic support across theatre services, with flexibility to provide assistance in Recovery as required. This role provides senior clinical leadership, supervising and mentoring junior staff, non-registered support staff, and students, while contributing to service improvement, maintaining operational efficiency, and ensuring compliance with mandatory training, policies, and SOPs. The post holder is professionally accountable in accordance with the NMC / HCPC Code of Professional Conduct and ensures alignment with national guidance. The post holder will work within a highly specialised Orthopaedic and Spinal surgical environment, delivering safe and effective perioperative care to patients undergoing complex procedures. The role requires the ability to perform efficiently in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, responding effectively to changing clinical priorities, emergency situations, and demanding surgical workloads while maintaining professionalism, attention to detail, and patient safety at all times. Clinical Responsibilities Provide expert anaesthetic support, including preparation, monitoring, and assisting during procedures. Support scrub and circulating staff throughout the perioperative period. Actively participate in emergency response teams. Including allocated resuscitation roles and daily safety huddles. Deliver patient assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation throughout the anaesthetic care pathway. Provide assistance in Recovery/Enhanced Care as required to support patient safety and flow. Maintain up-to-date skills and knowledge in anaesthetics and recovery care. Participate in the on-call rota and support flexible working arrangements. Maintain accurate, contemporaneous patient documentation in line with policy. Ensure safe handling, storage, and administration of medications. Conduct pre-use checks of all anaesthetic equipment and escalate faults promptly. Participate in audit, quality improvement initiatives, and action plan implementation. Maintain 100% compliance with mandatory training, national guidance, and organisational policy. Leadership & People Management Deputise for the Lead or Deputy Lead Practitioner when required. Provide clinical supervision and mentorship to junior colleagues, non-registered support staff, and students. Contribute to staff appraisal, development planning, and competency assessments. Support orientation of new staff, bank, and agency colleagues. Promote a professional, inclusive, and collaborative team culture. MDT Collaboration & Team Support Work closely with surgeons, theatre staff, anaesthetists, recovery nurses, and wider MDT to ensure safe, coordinated patient care. Support colleagues during periods of high activity or staffing pressures. Communicate effectively across departments to ensure smooth theatre operations. Governance, Risk & Compliance Adhere to all private-sector policies, SOPs, and national guidance including NICE, NatSSIPs, LocSSIPs, NCEPOD, RCoA . Report incidents, near misses, and risks promptly, contributing to investigations and learning outcomes. Ensure practice is evidence-based, up to date with clinical standards, and aligned with organisational procedures. Participate in policy updates and service development initiatives to improve patient care and operational efficiency. Maintain confidentiality and GDPR compliance at all times. Operational & Financial Responsibilities Contribute to effective theatre management, including coordination of patient lists, equipment, and consumables. Support revenue capture and ensure accurate use of resources. Identify requirements for new or replacement equipment, escalating where appropriate. Assist with service improvement projects within agreed timeframes and budgets. Knowledge, Skills & Experience Registered Practitioner with NMC or HCPC registration. Minimum 4 years post-qualification experience in an operating theatre environment. Proven experience in supporting complex elective surgical pathways in a high-throughput theatre environment Degree-level qualification or equivalent professional experience Strong clinical reasoning and decision-making skills across a varied patient caseload Experience supervising and mentoring junior staff and students Demonstrable ability to work autonomously and take clinical leadership responsibility for anaesthetic services on shift Evidence of Continuous Professional Development (CPD) Immediate Life Support qualification Advanced Life Support qualification (or commitment to work towards) Commitment to 100% compliance with mandatory training, policies, and SOPs. Mentorship / Practice Assessor qualification Sedation course Experience in budgetary management, service improvement, or revenue capture Experience supporting or leading clinical audits, quality improvement, or service redesign projects ** We are pleased to offer a £4,000 joining bonus for this position, subject to Fortius’ terms and conditions. Additionally, if you refer someone who is successfully appointed to the role, you may also be eligible for a referral bonus, subject to the applicable referral scheme terms and conditions. ** Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Assist in orientating new staffs, students and new members according to the local policy Takes responsibility as a shift in charge for the daily activity in the working area and for the staffs allocated roles. Strategy and Service Improvement Support the new changes and innovations implemented in the working area by providing support and feedback. Challenge existing practices, ensuring that progressive solutions consider models of best practise. Assist in managing service improvement projects within agreed timeframes and financial targets. Ability to remain calm, focused, and professional during complex surgical procedures and emergency situations. Resilience and effective stress management skills, with the ability to prioritise workload and make sound decisions under pressure. Ability to adapt quickly to changing clinical circumstances while maintaining high standards of patient care and safety. Proven capability to manage multiple competing priorities within a busy operating theatre setting. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Pallet </strong></p> <p>Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy, a $12 trillion global TAM. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. </p> <p>Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, and control.</p> <p>As companies across the physical economy look to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.</p> <p>Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.</p></div><p><strong>London, United Kingdom (Remote to start, transitioning to 5 days/week in-office once our local office opens)</strong></p> <p><strong>You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.</li> <li>Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.</li> <li>Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.</li> <li>Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.</li> <li>Help transform one of the world’s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the opportunity</strong></p> <p>We’re hiring Founding EMEA Enterprise Account Executives to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.</p> <p>You’ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest supply chain companies in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to drive a solution-selling motion centered around workflow discovery, AI use case identification, structured pilots, and measurable ROI.</p> <p>Initially, this role will be remote from London while we establish our UK presence. Once our London office opens, this role will transition to working from the office five days per week when not traveling to customer sites.</p> <p><strong>How you will make an impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the full enterprise sales cycle across EMEA, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.</li> <li>Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.</li> <li>Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.</li> <li>Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.</li> <li>Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.</li> <li>Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.</li> <li>Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.</li> <li>Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.</li> <li>Business-fluent French: you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in French. </li> <li>Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.</li> <li>Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.</li> <li>Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.</li> <li>Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.</li> <li>Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.</li> <li>Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.</li> <li>Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.</li> </ul> <p>Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is strongly preferred but not required. Candidates without logistics experience should demonstrate an ability to quickly learn operational workflows and become trusted advisors to customers.</p> <p><strong>Working model</strong></p> <p>Working hours are generally <strong>9:00am-6:00pm London time</strong>, providing full coverage of the European business day while maintaining regular collaboration with our San Francisco headquarters.</p> <p>You’ll typically spend:</p> <ul> <li>Mornings and early afternoons working directly with European customers and prospects.</li> <li>Late afternoons collaborating with our US-based Sales, Product, and Engineering teams during our daily overlap window.</li> <li>Approximately 75% of your time traveling across Europe for customer meetings, executive workshops, pilots, and industry events.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Reporting structure</strong></p> <p>You’ll report directly to our <strong>VP of Global Revenue</strong>, for territory strategy, customer relationships, and international expansion and will participate in weekly pipeline reviews, forecasting, and sales process alignment with the US team.</p> <p><strong>Interview Process</strong></p> <ul> <li>Chat with Christy - Business Recruiter - 30 mins</li> <li>Deal Review with VP of Global Revenue - 30 mins</li> <li>Discovery Mock Interview - 45-60 mins</li> <li>Final Interview - 2hr hours</li> <li>Brief Background Check and Reference Check</li> </ul> <p>We move fast, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage of the process.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>The estimated compensation range for this role is <strong>£220,000-£280,000 OTE</strong>, 50/50 split, depending on experience and skill set.</p> <p>Our compensation follows a standard 50/50 enterprise sales structure consisting of base salary and target commission. description: <p><strong>Purpose of Position</strong></p> <p>Our Retention & Growth Team is responsible for two keys areas;</p> <ol> <li>Customer Retention – ensuring long-term continuity and sustainability of our customer base. </li> <li>Portfolio Growth – expanding revenue in line with Gross Profit (GP) and Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) targets.</li> </ol> <p>This team leads the migration of customers onto new MarTech commercial models and updated contracts as part of the company’s wider business transformation.</p> <p><strong>In parallel, the team drives revenue optimisation by:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Upselling customers to higher-value Platform Offers or Service Packages</li> <li>Cross-selling additional services or add-ons</li> <li>Expanding existing customers into new markets or programmes</li> <li>Downgrading customers to more suitable Platform Offers or Service Packages where appropriate</li> </ul> <p>The R&G Project & AI Coordinator is an assistant-level role responsible for providing operational, contractual and project support to the Retention & Growth Team. </p> <p>A key focus of the position will be supporting contract reconciliation and contract management activities, ensuring that customer agreements, Salesforce records, internal approvals and supporting documentation are complete, accurate and aligned.</p> <p>The role will also support the team in identifying and implementing AI-based efficiencies. capacity.</li> </ul> <p><strong><br>Skills & Expertise</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide flexible support across the wider R&G function based on changing team priorities and capacity.</li> <li>An interest title: Growth Associate
description: About us Every large industrial company is trying to make better decisions with the data it already owns. Most hit the same wall. Strategy lives in one system, sales in another, the market model in a consultant's spreadsheet, and the plan in a deck nobody has opened since the offsite. By the time a regional head knows a segment has moved, the quarter is gone. The data exists. It just never arrives anywhere a decision is being made. STRATOS was built to solve this problem. We work with global B2B companies to synchronize strategy and execution and ensure commercial success is driven by potential, not gut feel or old data. STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup, profitable and majority founder-owned with our Series A still ahead of us, funded by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by 15 global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI. The role You own how we reach the commercial leaders at Europe’s largest manufacturers, and whether they reply. You plan and run the campaigns, make the calls, write the sequences, build the materials that get someone into a room, and keep the pipeline numbers our CRO takes to the board. You do all of it with AI tooling that lets one person cover what used to take a team, and you work directly with the CEO, CRO and CMO on what to try next. Tasks Run campaigns end to end. Plan, launch, and optimise outreach campaigns. Write, test, measure, iterate. Own outbound. Run cold calling, email sequences, and LinkedIn programmes targeting commercial leaders at Europe’s largest manufacturers, armed with the AI-recommended warm intro paths and account intelligence. Drive our paid channels. Organise, launch, and optimise paid campaigns, from targeting and creative through to spend decisions and attribution. Build materials that win meetings. Produce client documents, demos, and interactive presentations from our library of high-end content, using our templates and AI tooling. Fast turnaround, senior-team standard. Keep the engine clean. Log your activity, keep pipeline data spotless in HubSpot, and produce the weekly pipeline, coverage, and forecast numbers the CRO uses to manage the number and brief the board. Make our commercial engine sharper every week. New plays, new automations, new content for the library. What you build compounds. Use AI as a force multiplier. We are an AI-first company. You will use our AI tooling and automations to do the work of a team several times your size. Who this is for Most people who do well here have one to three years behind them in growth, sales development or commercial execution at a B2B software company, or a strategy background and a clear preference for doing the work over advising on it. You have run outreach yourself and can tell us the numbers: how many you sent, what came back, and what you changed when it didn’t work. You write well under constraint. Most of this job is persuading a busy executive in four sentences, and you know the difference between a cold email that lands and one that gets deleted unread. You reach for automation before you reach for repetition. HubSpot, Sales Navigator, sequencing tools and modern AI tooling are things you have used already, or will teach yourself over a weekend. You measure yourself on meetings booked and pipeline created. You are comfortable hearing that your campaign didn’t work, and quick to change it. This probably isn’t for you if you want a defined remit, a marketing role one step removed from the phone, or a job where someone else owns the number. What we offer Equity through our stock option programme, so you share in the long-term success and growth of the company A highly competitive salary Direct access to Fortune 500 executives from your first months, at a level most people wait a decade for Work alongside former MBB consultants and Fortune 500 executives who will teach you directly — our team is small enough that this happens in person, not through a training curriculum Private healthcare Pension scheme 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays Work from abroad — up to four weeks a year, and up to two weeks at a time Hybrid office policy, with visa sponsorship available A company committed to social and environmental responsibility — we pledge to be a net-zero CO₂ company and donate 1% of our revenue to social causes Practicalities London-based, 3 days a week in our Farringdon office The process First round with our Talent Lead — 30 minutes Hiring Manager interviews with CRO – 30 minutes Stakeholder interview with CMO – 30 minutes Final interview with CEO – 30 minutes Any questions before you apply, email me at ----- Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Tech Lead - Terminals
description: About Ryft Ryft is a regulated payment facilitator and authorised payment institution building the infrastructure layer for modern commerce platforms. We enable marketplaces, SaaS platforms and multi-party ecosystems to embed and monetise payments natively. Our technology handles onboarding, compliance, orchestration, split payments and revenue sharing, allowing our partners to focus on growth while we manage complexity. We are now entering the next phase of scale, expanding into new verticals and building a category-defining embedded payments platform. About the Job Are you an engineering leader who wants to own the systems that connect physical point-of-sale hardware to a modern, scalable payments platform? We are looking for a Tech Lead to head up our Card Present (In-Person Payments) squad. You will lead the technical direction and hands-on delivery of the infrastructure that allows our merchants to take physical payments. You'll work across our C#/.NET backend on AWS, shaping how physical card taps and inserts securely communicate with our event-driven services, split funds, and settle correctly. This is a hands-on, high-impact leadership role. You won't just be managing a Jira board, you'll be deep in the architecture, writing code, mentoring your squad, and owning the technical strategy for our physical terminal estate. You will bridge the gap between cloud infrastructure and physical hardware, ensuring our in-person payment flows are as robust, scalable, and developer-friendly as our online ones. What You'll Work On In-person payments architecture: Leading the technical design for our card-present estate, ensuring low-latency, highly reliable communication between physical terminals and our AWS backend. Terminal & Gateway Integration: Building the critical paths that connect smart payment terminals and Point of Sale (POS) systems into Ryft’s core gateway and marketplace routing logic. Hardware-to-cloud flows: Handling the unique complexities of physical payments: offline modes, state synchronization, hardware webhooks, and complex failure modes. Security & Compliance pipelines: Ensuring our physical payment flows remain airtight and fully compliant within heavily regulated environments. Squad Leadership: Setting the technical standard for the Card Present squad. Breaking down complex product requirements into actionable architecture and guiding engineers through delivery. The platform itself: Contributing to our broader event-driven C#/.NET service estate, infrastructure-as-code, and observability tooling alongside other Tech Leads. Responsibilities Lead technical delivery: Architect, build, and ship end-to-end features for our card-present offering. You are the ultimate technical owner of what your squad ships. Design for hardware-cloud correctness: Write and architect services that behave under network drops, partial failure, and hardware concurrency. Idempotency and absolute accuracy are the job, not edge cases. Raise the bar & mentor: Improve the codebase and our engineering practices. Review code rigorously, set conventions, and level up the engineers in your squad. Own it in production: Take real ownership of what goes live: instrumentation, alerting, and incident response for a system where physical merchants are relying on your uptime to make a living. Harness AI, stay in control: Use AI-assisted workflows to multiply your output (we invest heavily in them) while remaining in full command of every line you ship and review. Collaborate: Work day-to-day with your Engineering Manager, Product Managers, hardware vendors, and other squads to deliver seamless omnichannel payment features. Experience & Skills Required Technical Leadership: Proven experience leading technical projects, architecting complex backend systems, and guiding small teams of engineers to deliver high-quality software. Strong backend engineering: Significant commercial experience building and running production backend services. Our backend is C#/.NET, so depth there is ideal, but if you're excellent in another modern typed language and will get fluent fast, we want to hear from you. AWS in production: Hands-on experience running distributed services on AWS (ECS/Fargate, Lambda, SNS/SQS, DynamoDB or similar) and understanding the operational reality that comes with them. Distributed systems judgement: Comfortable reasoning about service boundaries, asynchronous messaging, eventual consistency, and building resilient systems that handle downstream provider outages. AI-augmented, engineer-first: You use AI coding tools effectively to move faster, but you review, understand, and take full ownership of the output. We are not looking for someone who ships code they can't explain. Fast, self-directed learner: A track record of getting productive quickly in unfamiliar domains. Enthusiasm to master the complexities of hardware-software interactions matters more to us than knowing it all on day one. You'll work across everything from executive and client meeting support to Town Halls, Microsoft Teams events and streamed broadcasts , alongside proactive maintenance, fault finding and technology upgrades. Working closely with the Service Desk, Facilities, Events teams and specialist AV partners, you'll be central to delivering the seamless, professional technology experience expected within a fast-paced professional services environment. If you're an experienced AV professional who enjoys solving complex technical problems, working directly with users and taking ownership when the pressure is on , this is an opportunity to play a key role on an exciting new Kinly account. What you'll be doing Technical ownership: Act as the senior AV escalation point, taking ownership of more complex AV and collaboration incidents through diagnosis, resolution and, where required, supplier escalation. Meeting room support: Carry out proactive checks of business-critical and client-facing spaces, ensuring rooms and equipment are ready when they're needed. Live events: Provide technical leadership and hands-on support for high-profile meetings, Town Halls, Microsoft Teams events and streamed broadcasts. Troubleshooting: Diagnose AV and video-conferencing faults, including during time-critical client meetings and live events. Preventative maintenance: Carry out proactive maintenance and support approved firmware updates, upgrades and new room deployments. White-glove support: Provide a professional, client-focused service to users, including floor-walking, meeting support and guidance on room technology. AV projects: Work with Technology, Facilities, Events and external suppliers on room refreshes, upgrades and new technology initiatives. Service management: Log and manage incidents and requests through the ITSM platform, providing clear, timely updates to users and stakeholders. Documentation: Maintain accurate room configurations, troubleshooting information, resolutions and standard operating procedures within the technology knowledge base. Equipment management: Maintain AV equipment and spares, including microphones, cables and batteries, ensuring assets are available, configured and in excellent working order. What we're looking for We're looking for someone with strong hands-on AV expertise who is equally comfortable behind the technology and in front of the client . Ideally, you'll bring: Proven experience in an AV, unified communications or video-conferencing support role , ideally within a corporate, legal or professional services environment. Hands-on experience supporting Q-SYS, Biamp and Crestron environments, with a good understanding of DSP, signal flow, switching and control. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Teams Rooms and Microsoft Teams , including audio, video and connectivity troubleshooting. Experience supporting live events, Town Halls and streamed broadcasts . Familiarity with Poly video-conferencing technology , including Studio E60 and E70 cameras. Strong diagnostic and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain calm and effective during business-critical meetings and events. Experience using ITSM or service desk platforms such as ServiceNow . Excellent communication skills and the confidence to support senior stakeholders, clients and non-technical users. A proactive, organised approach with strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently as well as part of a close-knit team. Knowledge of AV-over-IP, IP addressing, VLANs and Dante would be advantageous. Certifications such as AVIXA CTS, Crestron, Q-SYS or Biamp would also be highly valued, but aren't essential. Due to the nature of the role, you'll need to be comfortable working the rotational shift pattern and providing occasional out-of-hours support for important events or critical business requirements. Why join Kinly? You'll be joining Kinly at an exciting point as we establish a new client account , giving you the opportunity to make an impact from the outset. This isn't simply a break/fix AV support position. You'll have the opportunity to take technical ownership, support high-profile users and events, work with enterprise AV technologies and help shape a consistently excellent client experience . For someone who combines strong AV expertise with outstanding customer service and enjoys being trusted to solve problems, it's a role with plenty of variety, visibility and responsibility. Inclusion and accessibility Kinly is committed to providing equal opportunities in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, gender identity, pregnancy, colour, race, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, religion or any other protected characteristic. If you're selected for interview and require any reasonable adjustments, please let our Talent Acquisition team know when your interview is scheduled. title: Senior Delivery Manager
description: Waracle are looking for a Senior Delivery Manager for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation. We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations. This is a Hybrid role working from our London office 2 days a week The Role Are you a collaborative delivery leader who excels at bringing people together, nurturing talent, and guiding complex projects to success? As a Senior Delivery Manager at Waracle, you’ll play a pivotal role in creating supportive, high-performing environments where cross-functional teams can thrive. You will lead complex digital transformations end-to-end, serving as a trusted advisor to clients while mentoring the next generation of delivery talent. If you enjoy empowering teams, tackling big ideas, and building meaningful partnerships, we’d love to welcome you aboard. Key aspects of the role include: Empowering & Coaching Teams: Coach cross-functional team members on estimation and prioritisation, fostering an environment where self-organisation, resilience, and psychological safety can flourish. Proactive Risk Management: Facilitate RAID sessions and guide risks to resolution in alignment with our Delivery Playbook, keeping projects smooth and transparent. Governance & Quality Delivery: Partner with teams to ensure large project outcomes meet quality standards, embedding best practices and "Definition of Done" outcomes. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Bring together Product, Design, and Engineering to build shared clarity on outcomes, manage dependencies, and celebrate shared wins. Stakeholder Partnership: Navigate complex discussions with empathy, simplify technical delivery topics, and build consensus among stakeholders. Thoughtful Commercial Stewardship: Use budget forecasting proactively to adapt team shape and spend, keeping projects healthy and aligned. Building Practice Capability: Mentor junior and mid-level Delivery Managers and help lead Community of Practice initiatives like tooling or delivery metrics. What you'll bring: Pragmatic expertise in multiple digital delivery frameworks (such as Agile, Lean, XP, or Waterfall) and a passion for adapting them to fit your team's unique needs. Proven experience managing risks and de-risking complex technical projects through open communication and structure. Strong commercial awareness, with comfort around budget forecasting and resource allocation. A genuine passion for coaching, mentoring, and lifting up talent around you. Clear, empathetic communication skills with a track record of building trusted relationships across clients and internal teams Recruitment Process 1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model. 2. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework. 3.Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. This will be a practical presentation. Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one Our Benefits We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect: Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions. Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution . For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones. Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind. Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working , providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are. Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth. Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme , and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts . Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs. Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally , building strong team bonds and giving back. We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age. title: Senior Product Designer, International Commerce
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.</p> <p>Empowering the world starts with living <a href="https://ouraring.com/about-us">our values</a> and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. </p></div><p>Our mission at Oura is to empower every individual to own their inner potential. The Oura Ring and its accompanying app help our global community gain a deeper understanding of their health, lifestyle, and sleep. The Commerce team makes that experience easy to discover, evaluate, and purchase across our direct-to-consumer website and other commercial channels.<br><br>Oura is looking for a <strong>Senior Product Designer </strong>to help make our international DTC experience first-class. This is an e-commerce-focused product design role with a clear growth mandate. You will take global DTC product work and make it relevant and compelling for non-US markets. That means more than translating pages or swapping images. You will design the local experience across content, creative, merchandising, experiments, payments, shipping, and checkout.You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Creative, Marketing, Analytics, Research, and market stakeholders. You will help us learn what should be consistent across markets, what should be adapted locally, and where local customer needs should change the product itself.This role reports to the Director of Product Design, Commerce.</p> <h3><strong>What You Will Do:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Adapt global DTC journeys for international markets, balancing shared foundations with local customer needs, behaviors, and cultural context.</li> <li>Design market-specific experiences across discovery, merchandising, product evaluation, product detail, purchase, membership, and post-purchase.</li> <li>Partner with local market, Creative, and Marketing teams to localize campaigns, imagery, content, offers, and brand expression.</li> <li>Translate local customer insights, competitive patterns, and business needs into global product decisions and reusable market-launch patterns.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to improve conversion, revenue, average order value, attach rate, and customer confidence across international funnels; seek to reduce time to purchase cycle</li> <li>Define hypotheses, success metrics, and experiments across acquisition, landing pages, product pages, bundles, upsells, membership, and checkout.</li> <li>Use qualitative research, quantitative data, funnel analysis, customer feedback, and experiment results to prioritize work and guide product decisions.</li> <li>Design and evolve cart and checkout experiences that support local payment methods, currencies, taxes, duties, shipping, delivery estimates, returns, and regional requirements.</li> <li>Create clear experiences for availability, inventory constraints, payment and authentication states, order confirmation, and other operational edge cases.</li> <li>Ensure localization improves relevance without changing the meaning of the transaction, price, product, or order state.</li> <li>Produce user flows, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, and implementation-ready specifications within Oura’s design system, responsive, and accessibility standards.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Operations, Payments, and Customer Care through critique, implementation, QA, launch, and post-launch iteration.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This role is a hybrid role out of our London office, with a preference for in-office 2 times a week.</strong></p> <p>This role will work across UK, EMEA, and US time zones, with a focus on our priority markets and creating a repeatable playbook for our emerging ones.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience designing digital products, with meaningful experience for e-commerce, DTC, marketplaces, or other transactional products.</li> <li>Experience designing for international or multi-market products. This may include localization, internationalization, regional content, multi-currency, local payment methods, shipping, tax, duties, or returns.</li> <li>A portfolio that shows strong end-to-end product design, from problem framing and exploration through launch and iteration.</li> <li>Experience using AI tools like Figma Make, Claude, Cursor to accelerate research, exploration, prototyping, documentation, or production work is a plus.</li> <li>Able to connect design decisions to funnel behavior and business outcomes without reducing design to a single conversion metric.</li> <li>Experience designing and learning from experiments, A/B tests, or other structured product tests.</li> <li>Strong interaction and visual design craft, including responsive web design, content hierarchy, prototyping, and design systems.</li> <li>Strong communication and collaboration skills to build strong working relationships with market partners</li> <li>Curiosity about customer behavior across cultures and markets, with the humility to learn from local experts and customers.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p>At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.</p> <p>What we offer:</p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary</li> <li>An Oura Ring of your own + employee discounts for friends & family</li> <li>Flexible working hours and remote working arrangements</li> <li>Wellness Time-Off</li> <li>Amazing culture of collaborative and passionate coworkers</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="styles--2Kv6p" data-ui="careers-page-content"> <p>ŌURA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at ŌURA are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.</p> <p>We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.</p> <p>Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers!<br>We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note:</p> <ul> <li>Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards.</li> <li>We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront.</li> <li>Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email.</li> </ul> <p>Stay cautious and protect your personal details.</p> <p>To all recruitment agencies: ŌURA does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, ŌURA employees, or any other organization's location. ŌURA is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.</p> </div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Marketing Automation Engineer
description: <h1>Growth at Private Equity Insights</h1> <p>The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?</p> <p>Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.</p> <p>The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.</p> <p>You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. title: Office Administrator
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring <strong>London Office Administrators </strong>to help take responsibility for the success of our London office. </p> <p>Our office administrators are part of our global business services team which covers business services, travel and logistics, events, expense management and administration. We look for positive team players who are self-driven and results oriented, with excellent attention to detail. The best candidates show that they are forward planners, reliable and determined, and keen to assume responsibility for projects, processes and policy. We are a unique global business, so we are not looking for candidates with extensive experience so much as excellent organisers and communicators who are keen to develop skills and strive for continuous improvement.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is an office-based role based in London.</p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Create a professional, positive and welcoming environment for colleagues and guests</li> <li>Proactive management of front-of-house, meeting rooms and desk space</li> <li>Clerical, administrative and logistical tasks such as ordering supplies, office equipment, and processing invoices</li> <li>Creating and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders</li> <li>Cross team collaboration across the company</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for</h3> <ul> <li>Excellent academics</li> <li>Excellent spoken and written English skills</li> <li>Responsible and accountable</li> <li>Self-awareness and thoughtfulness</li> <li>Ability to travel up to twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration</li> <li>Ability to grasp our existing technical systems and suggest improvements</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills</li> <li>Adaptability in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Pension and medical insurance</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description: <h3>About the position</h3> <p>We're looking to add a passionate Cybersecurity Engineer to our London office to help protect Jane Street’s employees, data, and infrastructure from the wilds of the internet. Our Cybersecurity Engineers are responsible for developing and using monitoring tools to guard the firm, as well as handling incident response and remediation when a threat is found.</p> <p>Our Cybersecurity team is a skilled group of programmers and security experts who are dedicated to keeping the firm safe. We consider ourselves to be tapped into developments in the broader cybersecurity space, and can tell the difference between the latest cool hack by security researchers and what actually matters in our day-to-day. In this role, you’ll carefully consider the context of our decisions as we think about the tradeoffs we’re making in our approach to resolving cybersecurity issues. We’ll expect you to apply a methodical approach to performing unstructured investigations to locate and repair the source of a security issue.</p> <p>You will also act as an ambassador of best practices to the rest of the firm. Team members understand and practice good personal cybersecurity hygiene, and are able to talk to others about it. A key component of doing well in this position is bringing everyone else along with you on the cybersecurity journey, and you should be excited to learn from your colleagues and pass that learning on to new analysts.</p> <h3>About you</h3> <ul> <li>Graduating with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field</li> <li>An avid follower of cybersecurity news</li> <li>A strong programmer who can demonstrate high potential and an aptitude for learning</li> <li>Comfortable and interested in managing your code and configs in version control, and knowledge of your editor (we don't care which though)</li> <li>Familiar with threat modeling, and able to clearly communicate your understanding of the tradeoffs we’re making to internal stakeholders</li> <li>Able to explain the cybersecurity decisions you’ve made in your own life, and how you’ve approached thinking about those decisions</li> <li>Able to adapt to changing scenarios and make challenging decisions under pressure</li> <li>Humble attitude about what you know and don’t know; not afraid to ask questions and admit mistakes</li> <li>Curious problem solver with a positive, collaborative attitude</li> <li>Fluent in English</li> </ul> <p><em>If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to ----- <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Organic Growth Manager (12m FTC)
description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. Sitting within the growth engine of the business, you’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Content, Brand, and Commercial teams to drive key initiatives forward. Highly self-motivated, you are comfortable setting priorities, solving problems proactively, and maintaining momentum across multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London | 💰£53,000 - £68,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <h4><br>Our Wealth team⭐</h4> <p>We’re looking to hire a Product Operations Manager to join our Wealth Collective and advance this strategically important area of growth for Monzo. Wealth is already one of Monzo’s largest and most strategically important businesses. The next phase is both challenging and exciting: growing our customer base, expanding into Europe, evolving our product range, and helping customers make better decisions across cash, investments and pensions.</p> <h4><br>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</h4> <p>Reporting to the Head of Wealth Operations, you’ll be responsible for overseeing day-to-day operations of a Wealth product line (Savings, Investments or Pensions). You’ll also help refine our operations strategy and optimise key processes to help us safely scale our products and features to millions of customers. </p> <p>You won't have a team to run day-to-day; instead you'll lead through influence, structure and expertise - bringing order to complex, cross-functional planning cycles, taking non-technical delivery work off engineers' plates, and being accountable for the success metrics in your area. You'll do this across two big strategic bets: going deep in the UK market and expanding our products into Europe, all while we scale to millions more customers.</p> <p>You will be able to leverage our established and award-winning customer service operations whilst also working closely with the Product, Engineering, Partnerships and Risk & Compliance teams to deliver a delightful experience for our users. In time, your remit may also expand to cover other products.</p> <ul> <li>Develop and implement operational strategies to enhance the growth of Monzo's Wealth business</li> <li>Drive high-impact initiatives in your area, defining how we implement compliant, scalable processes that are built for efficiency.</li> <li>Navigate ambiguity to bring structure to complex cross-functional planning cycles — including the operational readiness required for EU market expansion and deeper UK propositions.</li> <li>Ensure efficient, compliant, and seamless delivery of operations, serving as the key contact for escalations</li> <li>Drive best practices within the team for all internal operations, both supplier-facing and customer-facing</li> <li>Work with product managers, engineers, and designers to enhance product and customer experiences</li> <li>Monitor key performance and risk indicators to improve customer experience and operational performance, and manage regulatory compliance with Risk & Governance</li> <li>Oversee third-party provider effectiveness and collaborate with the Commercial & Partnerships Manager to optimise partnerships and operations</li> <li>Ad hoc project manage the implementation of new initiatives, such as supplier integrations, where appropriate</li> <li>Identify where digital tools and new technologies can make us more effective, and put them to work.</li> <li>Advocate for customers - don't just report feedback, but persuade Product Leads to adjust roadmaps based on qualitative and quantitative trends so we solve the most impactful problems.</li> </ul> <h4><br>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</h4> <ul> <li>Proven track record in designing and managing operations within financial services, banking, or regulated industries</li> <li>Hands-on experience in savings, securities, investment operations and/or wealth product, custody operations, transfers, reconciliations, ISA/SIPP administration</li> <li>Working familiarity with the relevant FCA and HMRC rules - e.g. CASS, ISA Regulations, COBS - and comfort operating them day-to-day</li> <li>Experience launching and scaling consumer products and working with third-party providers</li> <li>Strong ability to drive tangible outcomes, thrive in ambiguity with structured problem-solving, and challenge the status quo</li> <li>Analytical in developing scalable operational strategies, identifying key metrics to evaluate success, and highly detail-oriented</li> <li>Collaborative communicator, able to work effectively across functions, levels, and cultures, with clear and persuasive communication skills</li> <li>Fast learner who is humble, curious, and enthusiastic about building and scaling new initiatives to reach millions</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <h4><br>🙌 What’s in it for you</h4> <p>💰 £53,000 - £68,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role is based in our London office</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p> </p> <h4>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</h4> <ul> <li>20 min call with the recruiter</li> <li>Initial call with the Hiring Manager</li> <li>2 hours of technical and behavioural interviews</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>#LI-OS1<br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Sales Manager

Now, we’re exploring how we can help more established businesses switch to Monzo, across the UK and Europe 🚀</p> <p>Many of those businesses have more complex needs. They may need help understanding whether Monzo is right for them, moving their banking or getting the most from our products. A great conversation with the right person can make a real difference.</p> <p>We’ve started building a sales team and testing a more personal approach. Now we’re looking for a Sales Manager to lead a team of Account Executives and help us turn what we’re learning into a repeatable, effective sales motion.</p> <p>This is a chance to build something new. You’ll coach your team, help them deliver great results and use what you see every day to make the way we sell better. You’ll work closely with Revenue Operations (RevOps), Product and other teams to improve our processes and customer journeys.</p> <p>You’ll also help build an AI-first sales motion from the start. We want someone who’s curious about AI and automation, actively experiments with new tools and can help the team spend more time on conversations that matter.</p> <h3><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Leading a team of Account Executives.</strong> Manage a pod of 6–8 people and be accountable for its performance, from reaching the right businesses and converting opportunities to customer activation and quality. Translate the wider Business strategy and set clear expectations, understand what’s driving results and act when performance needs to improve.</li> <li><strong>Coaching and developing your team.</strong> Spend time listening to calls, reviewing opportunities and giving clear, regular feedback. Help each person build their skills and confidence, recognise great work and address underperformance fairly. Help hire and onboard new team members as we grow.</li> <li><strong>Building the sales motion.</strong> Turn what you and your team learn into better ways of working. Spot friction in lead handling, follow-up, handovers and the sales process; test improvements, measure their impact and share what works so we can build a repeatable playbook.</li> <li><strong>Staying close to customers.</strong> We expect Sales Managers to also take a few sales calls each week and make a few sales a month. Use what you learn from customers and the sales journey to coach the team, identify product needs and improve the motion. Most of your time will be spent leading the team and improving how we work.</li> <li><strong>Helping shape our Products.</strong> Share what you learn from customers with Product to help shape our proposition and priorities, and use what we learn to improve how we sell.</li> <li><strong>Putting AI and automation to work.</strong> Experiment with tools, agents and workflows that help the team research prospects, prepare for conversations, follow up or learn from calls. Work with specialist teams to test ideas responsibly, understand their impact and help the team adopt what works.</li> <li><strong>Making good decisions with data.</strong> Use pipeline, conversion, activation, productivity and quality data to understand where the team is doing well and where customers or opportunities are getting stuck. Keep the pipeline accurate and work with RevOps on reporting and forecasting.</li> <li><strong>Working as one team.</strong> Bring frontline insight to RevOps, Product, Marketing and Operations. Help shape the tools, processes and customer journeys Sales needs, and work together to solve problems that affect your team and customers.</li> <li><strong>Earning customers’ trust.</strong> Build a culture that puts customers first. Coach your team to understand their needs, represent Monzo accurately and deliver good outcomes. Raise concerns early and work with Risk, Compliance and Legal when needed.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You’ve managed and developed a sales team. You can share examples of how you’ve coached individuals, given feedback and improved performance, including when conversations were difficult.</li> <li>You understand selling to small and medium-sized businesses in a relatively high-volume environment. You can balance an efficient process with thoughtful, customer-focused conversations.</li> <li>You’re a builder. You’ve spotted a problem in how a team sells, tried a better approach and helped people put it into practice. You’re comfortable making progress when the playbook is still being written.</li> <li>You’ve actively experimented with AI or automation at work and are keen to explore what agents and new workflows can do. You can tell us what you tried, the problem you were solving and what you learned.</li> <li>You’re happy to stay hands-on with customers. You enjoy sales conversations yourself and use what you learn to help others improve.</li> <li>You use data to understand performance. You can look at a funnel or pipeline, ask good questions and turn the answers into practical action.</li> <li>You work well with people in different teams. You can explain what your team and customers need, share evidence and help colleagues find solutions together.</li> <li>You care about doing the right thing for customers. You’re comfortable working within clear standards and learning what it takes to sell in a regulated environment.</li> <li>You might have built your experience in financial services, technology or another business selling to businesses. We care more about what you’ve done and how you think than the exact path you took to get here.</li> <li>You don’t need to tick every box. If this role excites you and you think you could make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t have everything that’s listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <h3><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></h3> <p>💰 £60k – £80k base salary, plus on-target commission based on team performance. Total on-target earnings are approximately £100k – £135k</p> <p>📍 This role is based in our London office. You’ll work from the office at least 3 days a week to stay close to your team.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We’ll set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! title: Forward Deployed Architect
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes. This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value. You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams. The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption. - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale. - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation. - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value. - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback. - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path. - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements. - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role. - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria. - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions. - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows. - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively. - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value. - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness. - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences. - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward. - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers. - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows. - Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up. - Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements. - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate. - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps. - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles. - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room. - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working. - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria. - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve. - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles. NICE TO HAVES - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions. - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals. - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software. - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. title: Senior Financial Control Analyst, 9 Month Fixed Term Contract
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond.
